howto: Write each entry in 'files' to a folder with the deck JSON (vault decks/namor-merfolk saved as deck.json). Run: python3 nm_loo.py bracket2 3000 (leave-one-out) or python3 nm_tests.py bracket2 5000 (paired swap tests). Same opponent profiles as wssim.
modeled: Namor power and blue-pip token triggers, lords, islandwalk (blue opponents + Tideshaper), unblockable (Herald, Sovereign, Daughter, Pym), flying (Mist Dancer, Scourge counters, Zephyr Boots), connive, second-draw payoffs, draw engines (Bident, Attuma, Svyelun, Super Intelligence, Idol, Baxter, Looter, Kindred Discovery, Coastal Piracy), bounce/freeze/stun on blockers, instant-speed play on opponents' turns, counterspells protecting the board, Kopala/Svyelun ward taxes, block-aware attack planning. Nov 16 (v1.1): Chrome Host Seedshark (incubate X on each noncreature spell; {2} hatches an X/X when mana is spare), Treasure Cruise (delve), Timeline Inquiry (draw 3, no discard when untapped creatures have 2+ power), Thirst for Knowledge (discards an artifact when one is expendable), Assassin Gauntlet (cast before combat: taps the target opponent's creatures, +1/+1 and a loot on hit for the best attacker), Muddle the Mixture (as a counterspell).
name: Namor Merfolk simulator (v1.1)
not_modeled: Opponents attacking you, racing or comboing; politics; Aetherize; Back to Basics only as a flat 10% opponent slowdown. Muddle the Mixture's transmute; re-equipping Assassin Gauntlet after its creature dies.
